==Description==
The '''Narrator Mini Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers [[The Final Act Event]] [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]], though without [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Narrator}} skin for [[Crook Boss]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 13.6 inches (34.544 centimetres) tall, 6.3 inches (16.002 centimetres) wide and 6.3 inches (16.002 centimetres) deep.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:The Narrator Plush captures the flair, ego, and unmistakable presence of Tower Defense Simulator’s iconic showman. Designed as a display-worthy collectible, this limited-time plush brings the performance beyond the screen. This plush does not include an in-game reward.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Pyromancer Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $26.99.

The virtual item is also available in-game at the cost of {{Robux|1,199}}, though it will only give the skin and not the plushie.
